test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**harmony**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the** given words**:

 
 
• ​**Harmony: **the situation in which people live or work happily together without any big problems
 
• **Inner beauty**: refers to the personality of a person including his/her mind and character.
 
• **Pride: **consciousness of one's own dignity.
 
• **Praise: **the expression of approval or admiration for someone or something.
 
 
 
• ​​​As per the meaning of the given words, "**harmony**" is the appropriate option for the blank.
 
• The implied meaning of the given sentence is that Success can be defined as the ability to be happy and make others happy; the ability to love and be loved; the ability to remain in peace and happiness with oneself and others.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

The complete passage is: Although everyone wants to be successful in life, there are* (1) a few *people who know the elements of success, the factors that go to build up success. Today, success is being* (2) confused *with making money, with amassing millions and billions. Some people equate it with power and position. Many of us tend to equate success with visible material acquisitions. Outer things and external achievements are not a *(*__*3*__*)*__*measure* of success. Power, prestige, position, social influence and higher degrees awarded by universities - all these are outer things. They only touch the fringes of life; they do not enter the depths within. A man may have all these and yet may be intellectually barren; he may be emotionally barren and spiritually sterile. Would you call such a man* (4) successful*? What then is success all about? What is true success? Success can be defined as the ability to be happy and make others happy; the ability to love and be loved; the ability to remain in peaceful *(5) harmony* with oneself; with those around you and with God's cosmic laws.
